europe_now.title: Finland summons Russian ambassador over airspace violation
europe_now.summary: Finland summoned the Russian ambassador following a suspected airspace violation by a helicopter. The incident highlights ongoing regional tensions along European borders with Russia.

europe_now.title: National strike paralyzes transport in Belgium
europe_now.summary: A national strike in Belgium led to widespread shutdowns of airports and public transport as mounting protests disrupted the country. Labor demonstrations caused significant logistical halts across major transport networks.

top_stories.title: New EU sanctions targeting Russia
top_stories.summary: The European Union is advancing a new sanctions package aimed at Russian banks, ex-soldiers, and sports organizations. Officials intend to implement bans on Russian flags and teams at European sporting events.

top_stories.title: Emissions trading expansion debate
top_stories.summary: Eight European Union member states have formally rejected any further delays to including transport and heating in emissions trading. The policy discussion centers on maintaining strict timelines for climate measures.
